insert into qc_treatment_record
adm_no, order_record_id, patient_id, bill_pay_id, type, verify_code, remark, status, inservice, adm_date, sync_id, sync_time, upd_id, upd_time,
#{admNo}, #{orderRecordId}, #{patientId}, #{billPayId}, #{type}, #{verifyCode}, #{remark}, #{status}, #{inservice}, #{admDate}, #{syncId}, #{syncTime}, #{updId}, #{updTime},
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE
verify_code= VALUES(verify_code), adm_date= VALUES(adm_date), upd_time= VALUES(upd_time),

SELECT qcr.id AS qcTreatmentId, qcr.adm_no AS admNo, qcr.type, IFNULL(qci.originAmount, 0) AS originAmount, IFNULL(qci.originAmount, 0) AS receivedAmount FROM qc_treatment_record qcr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT qc_treatment_id, SUM(quantity * price) AS originAmount FROM qc_treatment_item WHERE inservice = 1 GROUP BY qc_treatment_id ) qci ON qcr.id = qci.qc_treatment_id
qcr.inservice = 1 AND qcr.order_record_id = #{orderRecordId}

SELECT qtr.id, qtr.adm_no AS admNo, qci.customer_name AS customerName, qci.id_card AS idCard, qci.mobile, qci.sex, qtr.type, qtr.adm_date AS admDate, qtr.patient_id AS patientId, qtr.status, qtr.verify_code AS verifyCode, IFNULL(qti1.adviceItemExecAmount, 0) AS adviceItemExecAmount, IFNULL(qti2.orderItemExecAmount, 0) AS orderItemExecAmount, IFNULL(qti1.adviceItemExecAmount, 0) + IFNULL(qti2.orderItemExecAmount, 0) AS receivedTotalAmount, qtr.sync_time AS syncTime FROM qc_treatment_record qtr LEFT JOIN qc_customer_info qci ON qtr.id = qci.qc_treatment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT qc_treatment_id, SUM(received_amount) AS adviceItemExecAmount, FROM qc_treatment_item WHERE inservice = 1 AND qc_collected = 1 GROUP BY qc_treatment_id ) qti1 ON qtr.id = qti1.qc_treatment_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT qc_treatment_id, SUM(received_amount) AS orderItemExecAmount, FROM qc_treatment_item WHERE inservice = 1 AND qc_collected = 0 GROUP BY qc_treatment_id ) qti2 ON qtr.id = qti2.qc_treatment_id
AND qtr.id = #{id}

SELECT * FROM qc_treatment_record
AND inservice = 1 AND id in
#{id}
ORDER BY type ASC, id ASC
